limits: parity_class_function_is_third has two hypotheses: IsFrameFunction (value sum 1 on every orthogonal triple of nonzero vectors of Q(i)^3) and ParityDetermined (on every Gaussian-integer vector with NOT all of a+b, c+d, e+g even, the value is a function of ((a+b) mod 2, (c+d) mod 2, (e+g) mod 2)). Its conclusion is the value 1/3 on exactly those Gaussian-integer vectors; the Lean file does not state it for other vectors of Q(i)^3 (combining it with frameFunction_smul and clearing denominators would extend it, but that combination is not a Lean theorem). The identification of the class with (1+i)-divisibility is not formalised: the theorem is about the stated residues (a+b) mod 2. It excludes only that (1+i)-parity-class ansatz; other parity-type constructions (for example classes in Z[i]/(2)) are not covered. Neither existence of a non-quadratic frame function on Q(i)^3 rays nor quadraticity of all of them is proved. The rejected file BornRationalPlaneObstruction is not part of the build and nothing in this receipt depends on it.
